user.title: Connect to Gleanvolt
user.description: Gleanvolt {minimum} or later, with its HTTP API switched on (Settings → Installation → API access). Create a key named `home-assistant` there, so the log and the sessions name Home Assistant as the source of what it starts.

data_description.host: The machine Gleanvolt runs on, for example gleanvolt.local or 192.168.1.20.
data_description.port: The web UI's port, 8090 unless you changed it.
data_description.api_key: The key's secret, from Settings → Installation → API access.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Gleanvolt discovered
zeroconf_confirm.description: {name} was found at {host}:{port}. Enter an API key from its Settings → Installation → API access (Gleanvolt {minimum} or later).

data_description.api_key: The key's secret, from Settings → Installation → API access.

reauth_confirm.title: New API key
reauth_confirm.description: {name} refused the API key. Enter a valid one from Settings → Installation → API access.

data_description.api_key: The key's secret, from Settings → Installation → API access.

reconfigure.title: Change the address
reconfigure.description: Where {name} is reached now. The API key stays as it is.

data_description.host: The machine Gleanvolt runs on, for example gleanvolt.local or 192.168.1.20.
data_description.port: The web UI's port, 8090 unless you changed it.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from that address. Check the host and port, and that Gleanvolt is running.
error.api_disabled: The HTTP API is switched off. Switch it on in Settings → Installation → API access, then Restart on Settings → Health.
error.unsupported_version: This is Gleanvolt {version}; the integration needs {minimum} or later. Update Gleanvolt first.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. The Home Assistant log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This Gleanvolt installation is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This Gleanvolt installation is already set up.
abort.wrong_device: That address answers as a different Gleanvolt installation.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often the live status is read. Car, tariff and option flags are read every minute regardless.

api_disabled.message: The HTTP API is switched off on this Gleanvolt.

not_ready.message: Gleanvolt is running but has not completed a poll yet.

no_single_entry.message: More than one Gleanvolt installation is loaded: name one with config_entry_id.

start_charging.name: Start charging
start_charging.description: Starts a mode with the fields given here, not the held parameter entities. Fails with the controller's reason when it refuses.

config_entry_id.name: Installation
config_entry_id.description: Which Gleanvolt. Needed only with more than one.

basis.name: Fast basis
basis.description: FastNoBattery: Full (until the car stops), Energy (reads energy) or Soc (reads target SOC).

energy_kwh.name: Energy
energy_kwh.description: Energy to deliver, measured at the charger.

target_soc.name: Target SOC
target_soc.description: The car's state of charge to reach.

depart_by.name: Departure
depart_by.description: When the car has to be ready. FastNoBattery: leave out to charge now.

priority.name: Charge priority
priority.description: Targeted: Cheapest, or JustInTime to hold the last stretch back.

rest_soc.name: Rest SOC
rest_soc.description: Targeted, JustInTime: where the car waits before the last stretch.

sun_only.name: Sun only
sun_only.description: Targeted: buy nothing from the grid.

low_tariff_only.name: Low tariff only
low_tariff_only.description: Targeted: charge only in low tariff.

stop_charging.name: Stop charging
stop_charging.description: Writes Stop to the charger and returns the mode to Off, clearing any standing target.
